chapter: Emmett Hardy and the river towns
title: Manuel Mineta, the High Society variation and Hardy
summary: He says the High Society cornet variation originated with Manuel Mineta, who taught it to Hardy, and that Red Allen got it by copying Hardy's version.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Growl, plunger and derby: the trumpet mute tradition
